rubric.2: Strong fit: same role family, has the role's primary language/specialisation, covers at least ~60% of the listed skills, and experience is within the range (+/- 1 year).
rubric.1: Partial fit: same family sharing at least 1/3 of the listed skills, or an adjacent family sharing at least half; or a strong skills match with experience more than a year outside the range. Judgement is used for career changers.
rubric.0: Not a fit (every pair not listed).

provenance: Drafted with AI assistance (Claude) by applying the rubric to each resume and every job; not yet reviewed by an independent human labeller. Export them for review with: python -m app.ml.eval_holdout --export-labels labels.csv
